[EVENT] User is planning a quick weekend getaway.  
[PREFERENCE] User has a personal style that is pretty casual and likes to pack versatile pieces that can be mixed and matched.

[EVENT] User is planning to pack a small pouch with pain relievers, antacids, and band-aids.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended additional medications and first-aid items including antihistamines, antibiotic ointment, hydrocortisone cream, motion sickness medication, cold or flu medication, anti-diarrheal medication, blister or burn cream, and hand sanitizer.
